selection.ranking_rule: within each target category, ascending rank_hash then raw_category/source/model_id; take first requested_per_category
selection.failure_policy: retain every frozen selection in the requested denominator; never replace unavailable, parse-failed, invalid, or unscorable assets

primary_4class_matched_overlap.claim_boundary: Primary four-category matched-reference panel. Storage furniture uses the pre-specified container-furniture crosswalk; the three appliance categories are exact raw categories. No table result is claimed.

table_alias_5class_sensitivity.claim_boundary: Nonexact category-alias sensitivity only. The table row uses coffee_table and must never be presented as an exact-category result or pooled with the primary panel. Desk is excluded.

shared_panel_constraint: For every target category shared by the primary and alias panels, the frozen ordered selections must be byte-identical.

nested_original.constraint: The first six ordered identities and selection hashes in every category and panel must exactly match the frozen v1 selection.

evaluation.ontology_alignment_input: raw package URDF link names only
evaluation.unsupported_joint_policy: report every joint type; types outside fixed/revolute/continuous/prismatic/planar/floating are counted explicitly as unsupported_or_other and are never silently reclassified

claim_boundary.dataset_role: curated pre-release real-data reference, not a generation method, excluded from generated-method rankings and pairwise method claims
claim_boundary.structure: package-level URDF structural validity and representation diagnostics
claim_boundary.ontology: package-name semantic recoverability and induced PartNet-ontology alignment sensitivity; not PartNet gold and not instance-level kinematic hierarchy correctness
